The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Compact. Durable. Ready for work.

The Ferris 300S-42, B23 offers commercial-grade features in a compact package ideal for homeowners and entry-level professionals. Built to last and designed for comfort, this zero-turn mower is perfect for properties that require maneuverability without sacrificing cut quality or durability.

Powered by a reliable 23 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series engine and equipped with a rugged 42” fabricated cutting deck, the 300S delivers a professional-grade experience for smaller spaces and tighter landscapes.

Features may include:

Compact Commercial Power
23 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series 8230 V-Twin engine provides reliable performance and easy starts.

Fabricated Cutting Deck
42″ two-blade fabricated deck with reinforced edges offers superior durability and high-quality cuts.

Smooth Hydrostatic Drive
Hydro-Gear® EZT® transaxles deliver smooth, responsive control and easy maneuverability.

Quick Cut Height Adjustment
Foot-operated deck lift with cutting height range from 1.5” – 4.5” in 1/4” increments.

Premium Comfort
High-back seat with armrests and ergonomic controls for improved operator comfort and reduced fatigue.

Built Tough
Compact frame with durable components made to withstand season after season of regular mowing.

Efficient Fuel Use
Large 3-gallon fuel tank keeps you mowing longer without frequent stops.

Great for Residential or Entry-Level Commercial Use
Ideal for tight yards, gated access, or smaller job sites needing commercial toughness in a nimble footprint.
